title: Light the first candle
message: Welcome to December! Take a quiet minute tonight to light a candle and enjoy the glow.

title: Hot chocolate time
message: Make yourself a mug of hot chocolate today. Extra marshmallows encouraged.

title: Today’s song
message: Put on your favorite holiday song and sing along, loudly.

title: Send a card
message: Write a short note to someone you haven’t talked to in a while.

title: Bake something
message: Cookies, gingerbread, anything. Share a few with a neighbor.

title: Cozy day
message: Warm socks, soft blanket, a good book. You’ve earned it.

title: Go outside
message: Take a walk and look for Christmas lights in your neighborhood.

title: Small kindness
message: Do one unexpected nice thing for someone today.

title: Memory lane
message: Look through old holiday photos and smile.

title: Fresh and festive
message: Peel an orange and enjoy the smell. Instant holiday.

title: Movie night
message: Pick a favorite holiday film and watch it tonight.

title: Make an ornament
message: Craft something simple for the tree out of paper or ribbon.

title: Call someone
message: Phone a friend or relative just to say hello.

title: Soup for supper
message: Warm, simple, and comforting. Tonight is a soup night.

title: Tree time
message: Decorate the tree, or just admire one.

title: Gratitude
message: Write down three things from this year you’re thankful for.

title: Game night
message: Gather everyone for a board game or cards.

title: Give something away
message: Donate a coat, a toy, or some food to someone in need.

title: Story time
message: Read a holiday story aloud, even if it’s just to yourself.

title: Treat yourself
message: Enjoy a little chocolate. No guilt allowed.

title: Shortest day
message: The winter solstice is near. Look up at the night sky.

title: Carol along
message: Hum a carol while you tidy up. It makes chores lighter.

title: Almost there
message: Wrap the last gifts and take a deep, happy breath.

title: Christmas Eve
message: Merry Christmas Eve! Thank you for opening every door. Enjoy the magic tonight.
